title: SlaThresholdEmission v1
$comment: Immutable Project-scoped threshold crossing and notification intent link. slaClockId plus clockRevisionRef identify the stored immutable transition revision; they do not pretend that the dynamic sla-snapshot read DTO is itself a revision. notificationIntentRef binds the durable intent ID to a hash of its immutable creation tuple and deliberately excludes its mutable delivery state/row version. Composed semantic validation resolves the exact internal clock/policy/calendar pins while publishing only the matching Project policy facet; verifies scope, clock cycle, target and elapsed business-second calculation; matches WARNING.warningIndex to the pinned ordered threshold; requires BREACH elapsedBusinessSeconds >= targetBusinessSeconds; and proves idempotencyHash from the canonical crossing identity. This payload contains no global capacity facts, source content or authorization grant.

clockRevisionRef.description: Exact immutable SLA clock transition revision. Its id equals slaClockId and its hash excludes read-time SLA evaluation fields.

policyFacetRef.description: Project-scoped public policy facet matching the clock snapshot; the internal clock keeps the full source policy revision.

notificationIntentRef.description: Stable reference to the existing mutable NotificationIntent header. creationHash is SHA-256 over the JCS immutable creation tuple (notificationIntentId, workspaceId, projectId, dedupeKey, sourceEventRef, targetHash, payloadHash, renderHash, commandId, expiresAt); mutable state, attempts and rowVersion are excluded.
